designer_note: Rules every extraction is judged by. All server-decidable: squared-distance and squared-speed comparisons, integer tick cooldown. cooldown_s * tick_hz and every regen_interval_s * tick_hz must be integers (at 20 Hz: 60 and 600/1200/3600 ticks). See docs/design/p1-02-mining-design.md section 2.

extraction.note: In range iff |ship.position - deposit.position|^2 <= (deposit.radius_m + mining_range_from_surface_m)^2. Slow enough iff |ship.velocity|^2 <= max_ship_speed_mps^2. Both evaluated on the authoritative state at the START of the tick the command is processed in (before this tick's movement integration). 150 m is about one second of travel at the 140 m/s top speed, and less than the 196 m it takes to brake from it: a player who arrives at full speed overshoots, which is the point. 10 m/s means 'stopped enough to be working', not 'drifting past'.
